title: Exact constant coefficient restriction preserves upper cohomological bounds
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be any scheme morphism and $A$ any commutative ring. Let $F=f_A^*$ be the actual canonical module restriction of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], equivalently the identified-coefficient pullback of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] using [lem-pur-proetale-constant-coefficient-comparison]. Let $K^\bullet$ be a cochain complex of $A_Y$-module sheaves. If $H^j(QK^\bullet)=0$ for all $j>b$ for some integer $b$, then $H^j(FK^\bullet)=0$ for all $j>b$. Here $FK^\bullet$ is the actual termwise restriction complex, and $Q$ is localization to the derived category [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. The construction also gives the cohomology isomorphism $H^j(FK^\bullet)\cong f_A^*H^j(QK^\bullet)$.

source.place: Section 0735; exactness from Modules on Sites, Tag 04JC

proof.text: The coefficient map is invertible by [lem-pur-proetale-constant-coefficient-comparison]. Define the restriction functor using the existing identified-coefficient ring-module pullback of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] and this concrete isomorphism; its object on M is definitionally proEtaleConstantModulePullback f A M. The existing operation properties give additivity, finite-limit preservation, and finite-colimit preservation.

Apply the standard homology comparison for a functor preserving kernels and cokernels to the short complex K.sc(j). Compose with the inverse of the image of DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactors. This constructs H^j(FK)≅f_A^*H^j(QK). If j>b, the right side is zero because additive functors preserve zero objects; transport that zero object across this isomorphism. The same b works, including the acyclic and empty-scheme cases.

theorem proEtaleConstantModulePullback_boundedAbove {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    (K : CochainComplex (proEtaleRingModules Y (proEtaleConstantRing Y A)) ℤ)
    (hK : ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ j : ℤ, b < j → IsZero
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (proEtaleRingModules Y
        (proEtaleConstantRing Y A)) j).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K))) :
    ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ j : ℤ, b < j → IsZero
      (((proEtaleConstantModulePullbackFunctor f A).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) |>.obj K).homology j)
